notes: «عن خالته أم حرام» : the relation word «خالته» is directly followed by the name, so the link is the name alone (rule 1)
«قالت» makes Umm Haram the source of the story, so she is the last link; the Prophet's dialogue inside the story is not a link
«عبادة بن الصامت» and «معاوية» in the closing narrative are not transmitters; offsets are approximate
